items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I stayed down there with my cousin, Henrietta.

ctx.x: Another thing I wanted to ask you is when did you come to New Orleans the first time here, remember?

The first time? Mm-hmm. Oh, I used to partly live down there when I was a kid, you know. My mother, she used to go out with my father like that. She used to sing sometimes. Mm-hmm. We'd have kind of a little show like with the man. And I was a baby. Well, my cousin, she lives up in Grittling now. She used to have me with her all the time, mine and me, you know, babysitter. So she take me from Platt when she lived down there on that canal back there. Take me down there. And I was a baby around there. When I went…
Well, we had a little discussion. When did they start putting the screen in on street cars? When you came down here at the first, could everybody sit together and mix it up?
